hubContentNotes.hot-tub-repair-and-servicing: THE REPAIR AND SERVICING HUB (operator, 3 Nov 2026). Articles are 'Hot Tub Repair and Servicing in [Town]', for people searching 'hot tub repair <town>' and 'hot tub servicing <town>'. Cover, from SITE-PLAN.md Section 1 ('Product and service detail'): residential AND commercial hot tubs; the service itself step by step (the live site's nine-step service: line flush with jets on full power for 45 minutes, drain, vacuum the footwell and every jet line, clean the shell, lid and steps, inspect and clean the filters, refill and balance the chemicals); automated pH balancing and chemical dosing (what David described: domestic tubs need manual chemical balancing, automated dosing comes with a commercial spa and plant room, and Arctic Spas' Spa Boy is the domestic route to automated saltwater water care); plant-room maintenance, servicing and repair for commercial spas; leaking and neglected tubs; and a short mention of installation, linking to the installation hub (most of the business is installs; this hub is the repair and servicing angle). Coverage wording: Cumbria, North Lancashire and North Yorkshire. No service price is published: contact for a quote. On this page and in every article, say in passing that Cumbria Spas serves residential and commercial customers of all types, from hotels to spas to leisure centres. Every call to action reads 'Contact by the quote form, call now, or by WhatsApp.'
hubContentNotes.wood-fired-hot-tubs: Lead the page with wood-fired tubs as David sells them: most buyers choose the model with hydrotherapy jets and LED lights, which plug into a standard 13-amp socket for the jets and lights only (the stove does the heating). The completely off-grid starter model exists but is a small share of sales, so it is a section, not the headline (David's WhatsApp, 6 Oct 2026). The range is made by Kubilų pasaulis, so name it: 'Cumbria Spas works in partnership with Kubilų pasaulis, the largest manufacturer in Lithuania of premium, luxury and custom hot tubs' (approved by the operator on 4 Nov 2026 for every page, articles included. That it is the largest manufacturer in Lithuania is the manufacturer's own claim and already on the live site; 'premium, luxury and custom hot tubs' is the operator's wording. Attribute it to Kubilų pasaulis and never make it a claim about Cumbria Spas). Never call it just 'a Lithuanian manufacturer'. Keep the live site's advantages: renewable wood heat with less reliance on electricity, off-grid use, the traditional bathing experience with the natural aroma of burning wood, and lower running costs with your own wood. Heat-up, temperature control by the stove vent, and the digital thermometer are in SITE-PLAN.md Section 1. The hero image must be a wood-fired tub. On this page and in every article, say in passing that Cumbria Spas serves residential and commercial customers of all types, from hotels to spas to leisure centres. Every call to action reads 'Contact by the quote form, call now, or by WhatsApp.' No prices anywhere: 'contact for prices' or 'contact for a quote'.
